sprint_trio.work_locus: the sample sprint the installer shipped — replace with your first real sprint

notes: Seed manifest, written by scripts/install.sh so /brief renders on the first session. Three things to do as you go: (1) set cycle_label, pillar and opened_at to your real first cycle; (2) point sprint_trio[0].id at your own sprint once you copy SAMPLE-01; (3) add the validation and consolidation entries when you open those sprints — see docs/three-sprint-cascade.md. sprint_root is resolved relative to the directory holding .foreman/, and may be an absolute path. Field reference: docs/cycle-architecture.md.
